pr465.title: Consolidate event operations against current integrity and authentication guards
pr465.body:
The event delivery chain conflicted with current main, and its older adapter overwrote stronger deletion, dependency-approval and RACI guards. This consolidation preserves the source histories through #417 plus the additional #339 successor, while retaining current integrity, authenticated-session revocation, source identity and migration ancestry.

Main `49f1f0ec087067d17f62d91df1b616eb053eb894` is normally merged into this branch. The web publication-selection behavior and event follow flow coexist; generated API clients reproduce exactly. Mobile companion [TDF-mobile#115](https://github.com/diegueins680/TDF-mobile/pull/115) is pinned at `ede1f2a0ccf75f3794c7892f291e1751b279d19e`, which preserves both previous mobile histories. It still needs independent review and integration.

The latest repair makes successful follow/unfollow writes refresh shared viewer and artist caches even after navigation. Navigation and analytics effects remain bound to their original profile/session lifetime. The logistics task CTA is deferred while adapter migrations are outside the production manifest and `event.operations.api` is disabled. The direct task route and isolated enabled-adapter validation remain intact. Two historical catalog successor mappings now point to the current reviewed sources; original decision payloads, previous successor IDs, source provenance and all regression assertions are preserved.

Validation actually executed:
- Current merged application: complete Stack build; freshly built Hspec executable passed 3,576 examples with zero failures and six existing separate-runner cases pending in that executable. The unchanged production-auth HTTP harness passed 107 cases against an isolated native PostgreSQL16 database, which was removed afterward.
- Current merged UI: 241 suites / 2,648 tests, production build and initial bundle budget passed. After the latest follow/link repair: 27 focused UI tests, including delayed follow/unfollow completion and all existing logout/session/navigation guards, passed; zero-warning lint and typecheck passed.
- Five unchanged catalog regression tests, the full 1,170-candidate no-unreviewed/no-stale gate, regenerated specification inventory, 83 release tests, 32 CI contract tests, repository quality and the unchanged dependency-security gate passed. Security-policy success does not mean zero dependency findings.
- Hosted validation on the preceding `23ff8f588` head passed complete-schema, PostgreSQL task/API/RACI suites and generated API contracts. Local Docker was unresponsive; no local Docker rehearsal pass is claimed for this integration. The native PostgreSQL HTTP result is separate evidence.
- Earlier event implementation validation includes eight isolated runtime suites, eight real RACI desktop/phone browser cases and formal negative controls, retained in the audit record. These are historical results, not substitutes for the new head's CI.

Merge gates: all prescribed checks must pass on the current head; obtain fresh independent approval, integrate the approved mobile companion, and recheck head/base/threads/compatibility. No source PR is superseded until this replacement actually merges. No deployment, feature activation, branch deletion, force push or administrator bypass is authorized by this implementation.
